import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom_len = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')

print("=== STEP 1: Filter CpGs with >90% or <10% methylation ===")
filtered = cpg[(cpg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
print(f"Total rows: {len(cpg)}")
print(f"Filtered rows (>90% or <10%): {len(filtered)}")
print(f"Filtered rows with >90%: {len(cpg[cpg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90])}")
print(f"Filtered rows with <10%: {len(cpg[cpg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10])}")

print("\n=== STEP 2: Get unique filtered CpG positions ===")
unique_filtered = filtered['Pos'].unique()
print(f"Unique filtered CpG positions: {len(unique_filtered)}")

# Get chromosome for each unique position
unique_filtered_df = filtered.drop_duplicates(subset='Pos')[['Pos', 'Chromosome']].copy()
print(f"\nUnique filtered CpGs per chromosome:")
chrom_counts = unique_filtered_df['Chromosome'].value_counts().sort_index()
print(chrom_counts)

print("\n=== STEP 3: Calculate per-chromosome density ===")
# Ensure chromosome types match for merging
chrom_len['Chromosome'] = chrom_len['Chromosome'].astype(str)

# Merge counts with chromosome lengths
density_df = chrom_counts.reset_index()
density_df.columns = ['Chromosome', 'Filtered_CpGs']
density_df = density_df.merge(chrom_len, on='Chromosome', how='left')
density_df['Density'] = density_df['Filtered_CpGs'] / density_df['Length']

print("Per-chromosome density table:")
print(density_df.to_string(index=False))

print("\n=== STEP 4: Genome-wide average chromosomal density ===")
# Average of per-chromosome densities
genome_wide_avg_density = density_df['Density'].mean()
print(f"Genome-wide average chromosomal density (mean of per-chr densities): {genome_wide_avg_density}")
print(f"In scientific notation: {genome_wide_avg_density:.6e}")

# Also compute total filtered CpGs / total genome length
total_genome_length = chrom_len[chrom_len['Chromosome'] != 'MT']['Length'].sum()
total_filtered = len(unique_filtered)
overall_density = total_filtered / total_genome_length
print(f"\nTotal genome length (excl MT): {total_genome_length}")
print(f"Total unique filtered CpGs: {total_filtered}")
print(f"Overall density (total CpGs / total bp): {overall_density:.6e}")

# Check if all chromosomes in CpG data have lengths
print("\n=== Sanity checks ===")
print(f"Chromosomes in filtered data: {sorted(unique_filtered_df['Chromosome'].unique())}")
print(f"Chromosomes in length file: {sorted(chrom_len['Chromosome'].unique())}")
missing_len = set(unique_filtered_df['Chromosome']) - set(chrom_len['Chromosome'])
print(f"Chromosomes missing length info: {missing_len}")

# Verify: how many chromosomes are in the density calculation?
print(f"\nNumber of chromosomes in density calculation: {len(density_df)}")
print(f"Sum of all chromosome lengths in density_df: {density_df['Length'].sum()}")
PYEOF

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom_len = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')
chrom_len['Chromosome'] = chrom_len['Chromosome'].astype(str)

# Step 1: Filter rows with >90% or <10% methylation
filtered = cpg[(cpg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
print(f"Total rows: {len(cpg)}")
print(f"Filtered rows (>90% or <10%): {len(filtered)}")

# Step 2: Get unique filtered CpG positions
unique_filtered_df = filtered.drop_duplicates(subset='Pos')[['Pos', 'Chromosome']].copy()
print(f"Unique filtered CpG positions: {len(unique_filtered_df)}")

# Step 3: Count unique filtered CpGs per chromosome
chrom_counts = unique_filtered_df['Chromosome'].value_counts()

# Step 4: Build density table for ALL chromosomes (excluding MT)
# Start with all chromosomes from length file (excluding MT)
all_chrom = chrom_len[chrom_len['Chromosome'] != 'MT'].copy()
all_chrom = all_chrom.rename(columns={'Length': 'Length'})

# Merge with counts (chromosomes without filtered CpGs get NaN -> 0)
density_df = all_chrom.copy()
density_df['Filtered_CpGs'] = density_df['Chromosome'].map(chrom_counts).fillna(0).astype(int)
density_df['Density'] = density_df['Filtered_CpGs'] / density_df['Length']

print("\n=== Per-chromosome density (all non-MT chromosomes) ===")
print(density_df.sort_values('Chromosome', key=lambda x: x.astype(str).str.replace('W','42').replace('Z','43').astype(int)).to_string(index=False))

# Step 5: Genome-wide average chromosomal density
# Average of per-chromosome densities across ALL chromosomes
genome_wide_avg = density_df['Density'].mean()
print(f"\n=== RESULT ===")
print(f"Number of chromosomes (excl MT): {len(density_df)}")
print(f"Genome-wide average chromosomal density: {genome_wide_avg}")
print(f"In scientific notation: {genome_wide_avg:.6e}")

# Also show total CpGs / total genome for reference
total_genome = density_df['Length'].sum()
total_cpgs = density_df['Filtered_CpGs'].sum()
print(f"\nTotal genome length (excl MT): {total_genome}")
print(f"Total unique filtered CpGs: {total_cpgs}")
print(f"Overall density (total/total): {total_cpgs/total_genome:.6e}")
PYEOF
